message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a caricature of a man sitting in the corner of a room. The man has a large head relative to his body and wears thin-rimmed spectacles. He is shown hunched over, sitting on a tiled floor with his knees drawn up toward his chest. His right hand is raised to his mouth, with his thumb near his lips. He wears a bright yellow jacket over a dark suit and a white shirt. His expression is wide-eyed and tense. The background consists of dark blue walls meeting at a corner and a light-colored, checkered tile floor.

Large yellow text on the right side reads "AKBAR TERPOJOK SIAPA SENANG". Above the main magazine title "TEMPO" in large white letters, a red banner contains the text "Wawancara Agus Budiman, Korban Kepanikan AS?". Small text below the main title reads "EDISI 26 November - 2 Desember 2001". A barcode and the price "Rp 10.800" are visible at the bottom. The man is positioned centrally, taking up much of the lower left and middle portions of the frame.
